prepare_publish.callback_boundary: PreparedResourceMap.Prepare/TryGetValue invoke only ordinary user hash/equality; Publish/Remove/Clear use int buckets and exact owned slot links. No user callbacks after all committed slots are prepared and final generation check passes.
prepare_publish.capacity_prepared: int bucket capacity, committed master dictionary, per-entry metadata and pending-global set capacity prepared before publication. Existing buckets need no new allocation. No O(C*I) full-copy per single admission.
prepare_publish.assumptions: Stable consistent hash/equality, no reentrant comparers, no mutable keys/fatal/OOM. Within these limits Monitor excludes intervening prepare/publish writers. Publish owner/linked/stale-bucket validation can throw for internal misuse; not universal no-throw claim.

retirement.assessment: Every changed public/timed expiration path owns removed list before first mutation and awaits release in finally. Later required lookup/elapsed preparation exceptions cannot lose earlier retired values. Identity index retirement invokes no comparer; slot key/value/neighbours clear and empty bucket unlinks. Removed master entry has Slots.Clear after all identity index removals.

pending.assessment: Unpublished pending preparation failure disposes linked CTS. Published pending keeps owned operation/global capacity; rejection/fault/cancel/invalidation removes exact saved slot, nulls pending.Slot, releases capacity and completion without comparator. Old invalidated pending with null slot cannot unlink replacement. No ordinary callback between publish and global registration under stated scope.

capacity_and_memory.assessment: Admission checks committed+global pending+retiring, and release signals only after disposal attempt. Hash int.MinValue stored directly. Slot unlink clears retained resource/key fields; empty bucket removal and no bucket publish on prepare failure avoid failed-attempt history. Dictionaries may retain bounded high-water backing capacity; no per-index memory/device-RSS bound asserted.

bulk_index.assessment: Complete private index builds before any live resource slot metadata. Invalid snapshot retry clears private links; final monitor validates index/resource version, active membership, name and stopping. All owner dict capacity prepared then callback-free metadata+name publication.

timer_cleanup.assessment: Completion task registered under monitor before fallible timestamp/expiration scan; finally releases removed values and resolves published task, fault safely logged. Disposal waits captured cleanup task. No new provider-failure success contract for required public clocks.

source_assessment.contracts: Public signatures, cache observer serialized/awaited isolation, projection outside monitor, expiry thresholds, capacity ownership and current generation contract retained.
